definitions.full: H5864. Iyyim עִיִּים proper name, of a location Γαι , etc. (as if עַי ): 1 station of Israel on east border of Moab, before גָּד דִּיבֹן Num 33:45 , = הָעֲבָרִים עִיֵּי 33:44 ; 21:11 (all P; ᵐ5 ignores הָעֲבָרִים ). 2 city in Judah Josh 15:29 (P). עֵילוֺם see עוֺלָם below עלם .
